hooks.command: bash -c 'FILE=$(echo "$TOOL_INPUT" | jq -r .file_path 2>/dev/null); [[ "$FILE" == *.py ]] && uv run ruff check --fix "$FILE" && uv run ruff format "$FILE" || true'
bash -c 'cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && git diff --name-only --diff-filter=AM 2>/dev/null | grep "\.py$" | head -20 | xargs -r uv run mypy --no-error-summary 2>&1 || true'
